intro.narration: Tricycle terminal, midnight. A table blocks the line of parked trikes. Ka Dencio is waiting, and so is Kuya Rico.

intro.speaker: ka_dencio
intro.text: Hop in, kid. Don't be scared, Rico's on your team today. Says he owes you one.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Of course! I'm on your side, promise. This one's free, I mean, just a small cut of the winnings.

intro.speaker: ka_dencio
intro.text: Rico. You know you owe me too, right? Your gas money from last week.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Ka Dencio... you're here. Hello po. Nice trike, is that a new side mirror?

intro.speaker: ka_dencio
intro.text: Let's see how long your loyalty lasts, Rico. Let's roll.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Don't worry, kid. I've got your back. We're solid, like a steel trike.

intro.narration: Ka Dencio smiled and jingled his pocket. The clink of coins carried across the terminal.

intro.speaker: ka_dencio
intro.text: Hey Rico, I've got extra gas money for anyone who knows when to switch lanes.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: ...ehe. Just put down that three, kid. I'm only listening to... myself.

win.narration: Your hand is empty, even with a knife in your back.

win.speaker: ka_dencio
win.text: You beat me?! Even after Rico turned on you, you still won?!

win.speaker: kuya_rico
win.text: Uy congrats, kid! ...do I get a kickback, though? I was on your team earlier.

win.speaker: ka_dencio
win.text: Hmp. You're good, kid. Hop in, free ride, just this once. Don't tell Rico.

lose.speaker: ka_dencio
lose.text: Off I go! Thanks, Rico, good doing business with you.

lose.speaker: kuya_rico
lose.text: Sorry, ha, kid! It's just business. I'll post-date my apology!

lose.speaker: ka_dencio
lose.text: Come back. But next time, be careful who you pick as a teammate.

lines.speaker: kuya_rico
lines.text: You know, kid... sorry, ha. This is business, nothing personal.

lines.speaker: ka_dencio
lines.text: My offer's bigger, right Rico? Welcome to the right lane.

lines.speaker: kuya_rico
lines.text: Don't be mad, I'll just post-date the betrayal.

lines.speaker: ka_dencio
lines.text: Only three left?! It's two against you now, and you're still this close?!
